name: Chessa
backstory: Chessa is an Undead Vampire Spawn who is imprisoned in Cazador's Dungeon. She is one of the children recently kidnapped from the Gur by Astarion and forcibly turned into a vampire spawn.
voice_hint: vampire spawn (voiced by Lucy Paterson, Luisa Guerreiro)
